rationale: The Latin anchors *defendere* and *protegere* both denote shielding from harm or danger, which maps directly to protect.v.01 ("shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage"). Protect.v.02 refers specifically to economic/tariff protectionism, which has no relevance to the Old English military/defensive context attested in Ors. 5, 3 and Bar. 182, 19.
